integrity: The 2026 primary full text was inspected at the random-inspection functional, exponential inspection model, sensitivity-profile interpretation, complete-data estimator, and Appendix exponential formulas. The 2025 random-age MRL paper was inspected at its general representation, conditional-MRL representation, comparison theorem, and conclusion. Classical MRL characterization literature was compared for scope. The proof is analytic and the bundled checker independently replays the Laplace reconstruction and zero-mass invariance.
scientific_limitations: Identification requires the population profile over all positive inspection rates; finitely many rate evaluations do not identify an unrestricted law.
The profile cannot identify the atom at zero; it identifies exactly the conditional law given positive lifetime.
The population theorem does not remove information loss from finite-horizon right censoring.
title: Exponential-inspection MRL profiles identify the positive lifetime law
